name: 3-Ingredient Cottage Cheese Chocolate Mousse

instructions.primary_message: In a medium microwave-safe liquid measuring cup, add chocolate. Microwave on high power in 30-second intervals, stirring with a rubber spatula after each interval, until melted, about 90 seconds. Let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a blender, process cottage cheese, maple syrup, and water until smooth, 30 to 60 seconds, stopping to scrape down sides of blender as needed. With blender running, drizzle in cooled chocolate until just combined, about 15 seconds, stopping to scrape down sides of blender as needed.

Transfer chocolate mousse to 2 (227 g) glasses, jars, or ramekins. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate until fully chilled and set, about 2 hours. Serve with whipped cream, berries, shaved chocolate, and flaky sea salt, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: chocolate mousse, cottage cheese chocolate mousse, chocolate dessert, healthy desserts

description: This three-ingredient chocolate mousse uses cottage cheese for a smooth, creamy texture and a light yet satisfying dessert.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 2 hr 10 min.

Notes: Use full-fat cottage cheese for the best results; its higher fat content helps create a smoother emulsion and a richer, creamier mousse.

Make-ahead and storage: The mousse can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated, covered with plastic wrap, for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
